integrity: Exact symbolic derivations and rational direct-inverse comparisons are reproducible with the included program; the theorem for all dimensions follows analytically. Bibliographic novelty remains subject to independent external confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Complete step-size sets are established only for dimensions at most four. In all higher dimensions the theorem proves failure of unconditional positivity at one universal step, not the complete positivity set. Unit-rate unweighted Boolean cubes and the two-stage Radau IIA completed step only.
title: Sharp Radau positivity loss and reentry on Boolean hypercubes
